build_DETR_model: build a DETR 3D voxel detection model, criterion, and postprocessor from args config
create_DETR_forward: create a DETR model instance and run forward pass on a NestedTensor sample batch
test_SetCriterion_loss: test the SetCriterion loss computation by computing labels, boxes, and masks loss on outputs
run_PostProcess_outputs: run PostProcess on DETR model outputs to convert predicted boxes and extract scores and labels
review_SetCriterion_match: review the SetCriterion match method to understand bipartite matching between predictions and targets
